message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Short-Term Asset Growth", "construction": "Percentage change in total current assets over the prior fiscal year, using data from Compustat annual balance sheets.", "rationale": "Rapid asset growth may signal overinvestment or empire-building, while slower asset growth may indicate disciplined capital allocation.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with low short-term asset growth"}, {"name": "Inventory Turnover Acceleration", "construction": "Year-over-year change in inventory turnover ratio (COGS divided by average inventories) calculated from Compustat annual data.", "rationale": "Improving inventory turnover suggests increasing operational efficiency and potential future profitability.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with large positive changes in inventory turnover"}, {"name": "Long-Term Debt Reduction", "construction": "Percentage decrease in long-term debt over the past three fiscal years, from Compustat balance sheets.", "rationale": "Firms reducing leverage may be de-risking, signaling stronger future performance.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with large reductions in long-term debt"}, {"name": "Operating Expense Slope", "construction": "Regression slope of SG&A expenses to sales over the past five fiscal years, using Compustat annual income statements.", "rationale": "A declining SG&A-to-sales ratio may indicate increasing scalability and profitability.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with the most negative slopes (fastest declining SG&A-to-sales ratios)"}, {"name": "Dividend Initiation", "construction": "Indicator variable equal to one if a firm initiates a dividend in the past year (Compustat dividend data), zero otherwise.", "rationale": "Dividend initiation may signal management confidence in stable cash flows.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks initiating dividends"}, {"name": "Earnings Estimate Dispersion", "construction": "Standard deviation of IBES analyst EPS forecasts for the next fiscal year, scaled by the mean forecast.", "rationale": "High dispersion reflects disagreement and greater uncertainty, which may be associated with higher risk and future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with high earnings forecast dispersion"}, {"name": "Cash Flow Consistency", "construction": "Standard deviation of operating cash flows divided by average cash flows over past five years (Compustat cash flow statement).", "rationale": "Consistent cash generators may be undervalued due to investor preference for smooth earnings.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with low cash flow variability"}, {"name": "Delayed Price Momentum", "construction": "Past 12-month stock return measured from 13 to 1 months ago, skipping the most recent month (CRSP monthly returns).", "rationale": "Lagged momentum signals may capture investor underreaction missed by traditional momentum measures.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with high past 12-month returns excluding the last month"}, {"name": "Insider Net Purchases", "construction": "Net purchases of shares by insiders over the past year divided by shares outstanding, from SEC Form 4 filings.", "rationale": "Insider buying can indicate undervaluation or positive private information.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with high net insider purchases"}, {"name": "R&D Intensity Change", "construction": "Year-over-year change in R&D expense divided by total assets, using Compustat annual data.", "rationale": "Increasing R&D intensity may predict future innovation and growth.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with largest increases in R&D-to-assets ratio"}]}
